description: Recommended values for blocks[].role in a workout. A plain classifier: it says what a block is for, not how it is executed. Execution is blocks[].mode, which is a closed discriminator (RFC-007 §3.2).

entries.label: Warm-up
entries.description: Preparatory work. Sets here are conventionally excluded from training volume.

entries.label: Primary
entries.description: The main work of the session, usually the heaviest or most technical.

entries.label: Accessory
entries.description: Supporting work chosen to serve the primary movements.

entries.label: Conditioning
entries.description: Metabolic work inside a session whose main intent is something else.

entries.label: Cool-down
entries.description: Down-regulating work at the end of a session.

entries.label: Finisher
entries.description: A short high-effort block placed last, by intent rather than by leftover.

entries.label: Skill
entries.description: Technique practice, typically early and deliberately non-fatiguing.

entries.label: Activation
entries.description: Targeted preparatory work for a specific muscle or pattern before the primary block.
